# app-media

The media code the programs compile in: container input, stream playback, recording sinks, the AC-4 object renderer. Internal; compiled into Forge, Hearth and Crucible.

A app library, internal to the repository.

- **Uses:** `ac3`, `ac4`, `containers`, `objects`, `render`
- **Used by:** `forge`, `hearth`
- **CI lanes:** windows, linux, macos

## Build and test

```sh
cmake --preset config-linux-gcc && cmake --build --preset build-linux-gcc
ctest --preset test-linux-gcc -L app-media
```

All the projects are in the one CMake build; `ctest -L` runs this project's tests alone.
